# MeedyaDL 1.11.0-alpha.18

First pre-release on the new **1.11.0** line — the multi-service UI refresh + prep work for the upcoming BBC iPlayer / Spotify / YouTube engines.

### What's new

- **New 1.11.0 release line** for the responsive queue + multi-service UI refresh work. 1.10.x stays as the stable line carrying the GAMDL 3.6/3.7 + Profile Bundle work that shipped in `v1.10.0`. The 2.0.0 jump is reserved for when BBC iPlayer ships and multi-service goes from "prep" to "real."

### What's fixed

- (Subsequent `1.11.0-alpha.N` pre-releases will fill in the actual user-facing changes as they land: responsive columns that adapt to your window size, per-row platform identity, album-art thumbnails, status indicators, quick actions, small polish animations, and undo for destructive actions.)

### Performance

- (No performance changes in alpha.18. Pre-release notes will be updated as subsequent changes land on this line.)

### Notes

- This is a pre-release on the **alpha** channel. A hidden developer mode lets users opt in to early channel switching; otherwise the in-app updater serves the latest stable from the 1.10.x line.
- The 1.11.0 line stays compatible with 1.10.x — your Profile Bundle exports, settings, queue, and download index all carry forward intact. Downgrading from 1.11.x to 1.10.x is supported.
- If you're testing on Alpha and the UI changes don't appear in alpha.18, that's expected — alpha.18 only changes the version numbers. The actual UI work begins landing in alpha.19+.
